snippet.title: Grokit: Purrtropolis - Official Summer Update Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Watch the latest Grokit trailer to see what to expect with the Purrtropolis summer update, which brings game modifiers, Photobooth, and more to the mixed reality social multiplayer hand-tracking party game. The Grokit: Purrtropolis summer update will be available this July 2025.
